foundations.summary: Ash, ruins, old battlefields, funeral smoke, burned scriptures, remnant spirits, and destroyed lineages resonate with your core. Loss does not pass through you cleanly; it leaves usable shape, but feeding on ruin can turn the core into hunger.

tianxia.sphere.alchemy.derivation_rule: Direct canonical Sphere interface name; compatibility hook only, never a grant.
tianxia.sphere.alchemy.exact_excerpt: **Effect:** Your maximum CP increases by your Proficiency Bonus. Your legal Ash, Death, Fire, Karma, Fate, Dark, Radiance, Protection, Dreams, Ink, Hunger, and Alchemy techniques may count as Foundation-aligned only when they clearly express ash, fire aftermath, death consequence, remnant memory, funeral authority, survivor protection, burned scripture, ruined lineage, or transformation after loss. You have Advantage on Wisdom saving throws against remnant possession, ruin-terror, grief-based control, despair pressure, battlefield horror, and hostile effects that try to make you seek destruction as proof of truth. This grants no sphere access, no automatic immunity, and no passive once-per-round damage reduction.
